## History

Eben Wright is mentioned during [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Diana's canvassing trip for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). While visiting the Andrews household, [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md) claims that Eben Wright refused to give a cent to the society.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P0](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0000), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P16](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0016), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030)_
